overview.description: The VanEck Materials TruSector ETF (TRUM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in materials equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in companies across the materials sector. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by focusing on established market leaders with strong growth and operating performance. TRUM was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by VanEck.
